# Rent ATV Santa Teresa

> Self-drive 4x4 ATV rentals in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica. Fully automatic Can-Am, Honda and Kymco quads by the day or week, with helmets and free hotel delivery included, booked entirely over WhatsApp.

Rent ATV Santa Teresa is a delivery-only ATV rental operator serving Santa Teresa, Mal País, Playa Carmen and Playa Hermosa on Costa Rica's Nicoya Peninsula, with delivery also available to Cóbano and Cabuya for an extra fee. There is no storefront — quads are delivered to and collected from wherever a guest is staying. The business operates every day, 6:00am–11:00pm, and the only contact channel is WhatsApp/phone at +506 7238 8955.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rentatvsantateresa.com/): Overview of the fleet, pricing, delivery area and booking.
- [ATV rentals](https://rentatvsantateresa.com/atv-rentals): Full details of the Can-Am, Honda and Kymco fleet, what's included, and what to bring.
- [Pricing](https://rentatvsantateresa.com/pricing): Daily and weekly rental rates, deposit, fuel and delivery terms.
- [FAQ](https://rentatvsantateresa.com/faq): Licence requirements, road conditions, insurance, breakdowns and gear.
- [Blog](https://rentatvsantateresa.com/blog): Travel guides and local knowledge for visitors to Santa Teresa.
- [Contact](https://rentatvsantateresa.com/contact): How booking works and the WhatsApp contact link.

## Key facts

- Rates: $65/day under 3 days, $60/day for 3–7 days, $55/day over 7 days, $50/day for stays of two weeks or more.
- Every rental includes helmets, a locking cargo box, basic liability insurance and a full tank of fuel at pickup.
- A valid physical driver's licence from the rider's home country is required (a standard car licence is enough); a photo of the licence is not accepted.
- Booking and all communication happen over WhatsApp — there is no public email address or phone-only line.
